_comment: Alert rules for the desk. Edit freely; the server re-reads this file every cycle. Types: day_move (scope held|watch_in|watch_us, threshold_pct), margin_util (threshold_pct), fno_dte (days), earnings_within (days), price_level (symbol, region in|us|global, above and/or below), insider_cluster (fires when a 30-day insider buy cluster appears on a book/watch name), activist_13d (a SCHEDULE 13D or 13D/A filed on a book/watch name within N days). Each rule fires once per day per symbol. Read-only: alerts notify, they never act.
